# THE PINNED FUZZ VECTORS (docs/SPEC-TABLES.md §4.2). A mutant the wire fuzzer
# found once is a mutant it must never have to find again. The random pass is a
# search, and a search that has to rediscover a known red is a search that can
# miss it. Every vector here is seeded into every wire-fuzz run by its own name
# and fed to the leg and the oracle EXACTLY as it is, before the random pass
# starts, so the red it pins is a SEEK.
#
# A vector earns its place by having been a red. It stays as the regression
# gate for the fix that closed it, and its negative control is that fix
# reverted: the run must go red on this vector's name.
#
#   <name> <unit> <root> <file> [message]
#
# The file is a path from the repository root, so a vector may live beside the
# corpus it was mutated from. The trailing `message` marks a vector that is a
# MESSAGE and not a file (docs/SPEC-TABLES.md §3.3): its references resolve
# against the unit's announced table, so the FORM is part of what the index has
# to say about it.

# THE COUNT WHOSE OWN SPELLING RUNS PAST THE BODY IT IS FRAMED BY (§3, §4). An
# array body's `L` of 2 is the shortest that carries a header at all, being the
# element kind byte and one count byte, but a canonical LEB128 count is up to
# ten bytes and the header is read against the PARENT buffer rather than
# against the body's own L. A count spelled wide therefore leaves the cursor
# past the end it was framed by, and the span from the cursor to that end is
# NEGATIVE. The reference reads no elements out of it. The oracle sliced with
# it and panicked. Found by the random pass at mutant 99100 of seed
# 24845619678, on Certify run 33887252419.
stream_count_past_body streamdemo Feed testdata/wire/tables/fuzz-vectors/stream_count_past_body.bin

# THE FORGED POINTER CYCLE (§3.1, §4; schema#535, filed on #521 as G-19). One
# flipped bit in a three-node ListNode chain turns the middle node's `next`
# index from 3 into 2, which is that node's own index.
#
# A CYCLIC WIRE IS DAMAGE (Glenn, 2026-10-31: "It's perhaps the MOST OBVIOUS
# attack somebody would do on this protocol!"), so the whole load is refused as
# `malformed`. The vector's job here is the REFERENCE AND THE ORACLE AGREEING
# on that refusal. internal/tablewire's TestForgedPointerCycleIsDamage holds the
# engine's half.
pointer_self_cycle graphdemo Scene    testdata/wire/tables/fuzz-vectors/pointer_self_cycle.bin

# ILL-FORMED TEXT ON A MESSAGE BODY (§3, §3.3; schema#620). §3's one content
# rule holds over a form-`2` body unchanged in what it rejects, and §3.3 says
# so: a kind `12` payload that is not well-formed UTF-8 is DAMAGE, terminal for
# the batch here because a bit stream has no place to resume. NEITHER ENGINE
# CARRIED IT. The C++ reference's emitted message reader copied the bytes a
# byte at a time with no check, and the oracle's `text` clamped at the raw
# bound, so a body no reader should accept loaded silently into both, agreeing,
# and agreeing wrongly, which is the one shape a differential fuzzer cannot see
# on its own. It became a red the moment one engine was repaired, and this
# vector is what holds the two together from here.
#
# The bytes are `store_full_message` with one byte of `sku`'s payload replaced
# by 0xFF, which is a lead byte UTF-8 never spells. Nothing else moves: the
# length, the align and every field after it are the golden's own, so what the
# two readers answer differently is the content rule and nothing else. Its
# controls are the four in `make tables-message-form-negative-control`, two per
# engine, each of which parts the leg from the oracle on this vector's name.
message_ill_formed_text backenddemo StorePurchase testdata/wire/tables/fuzz-vectors/message_ill_formed_text.bin message

# A list's wire elements widen while its region uses the declared width.
# Before schema#713, C++ LoadMeasure omitted this extent, then Load reported
# a valid widening as malformed. The shared report row also checks counters.
list_scalar_widen listdemo Save testdata/wire/tables/fuzz-vectors/list_scalar_widen.bin

# placements count 2147483648: both storage paths refuse without a malformed event.
list_count_cap listdemo Save testdata/wire/tables/fuzz-vectors/list_count_cap.bin

# One key changes width; its map, rather than both map and entry, counts the event (#716).
map_key_widen mapdemo Chunks testdata/wire/tables/fuzz-vectors/map_key_widen.bin

# A scalar's truncated widened payload never lands, so it contributes no Widened event.
list_map_truncated_widen listdemo Army testdata/wire/tables/fuzz-vectors/list_map_truncated_widen.bin

# A skipped incompatible map repeat preserves the earlier decoded occurrence.
map_repeat_mismatch mapdemo Crews testdata/wire/tables/fuzz-vectors/map_repeat_mismatch.bin

# The enclosing count crosses L: the extent is 40 bytes, and the region load
# empties photos and marks damage. The builder path refuses its partial value.
list_count_cross_length listdemo Album testdata/wire/tables/fuzz-vectors/list_count_cross_length.bin

# Flags accept unsigned scalar widening in positional collections (#717).
list_flags_widen listdemo Mixed testdata/wire/tables/fuzz-vectors/list_flags_widen.bin

# A truncated message bytes payload fails before any length clamp is counted.
message_bytes_truncated backenddemo LoginRequest testdata/wire/tables/fuzz-vectors/message_bytes_truncated.bin message

# The key scan reads through an incompatible occurrence; the final key kind wins.
map_key_repeat_kind mapdemo Slots testdata/wire/tables/fuzz-vectors/map_key_repeat_kind.bin

# A damaged framed pointer arm cannot produce a pointee-kind mismatch.
pointer_arm_trailing streamdemo Feed testdata/wire/tables/fuzz-vectors/pointer_arm_trailing.bin

# A later map occurrence supersedes retained bodies even after a damaged key cleared its value.
map_retained_replaced mapdemo Text testdata/wire/tables/fuzz-vectors/map_retained_replaced.bin

# BYTES INSIDE AN ENVELOPE ARE SKIPPED, BYTES AFTER THE MESSAGE ARE NOT (§3).
# A nested-union arm whose L runs one byte past the whole inner union it
# frames is the append rule's case: a newer writer may add at the end, and an
# older reader steps over the rest of the envelope with the arm, counting
# nothing. The C++ leg once called it malformed against the oracle (mutant
# 72054 of seed 24845619678, messagedemo.ToolMessage); this is that shape
# built clean. The twin puts the same byte after the ROOT's terminator,
# outside every envelope, where it is malformed (serialize 2.0's end rule).
# Both are the reference leg's bytes, pinned by test/tables/main.cpp.
nested_arm_trailing     messagedemo ToolMessage testdata/wire/tables/nested_arm_trailing.bin
nested_arm_trailing_top messagedemo ToolMessage testdata/wire/tables/nested_arm_trailing_top.bin

# A REGION READ WHOSE LIST COUNT THE FRAMED STORAGE CANNOT HOLD reports damage
# and RESUMES after the array's L (§3, §6.5; the oracle's collectionCap): the
# next field is still read. Here it is an unknown id under a kind outside the
# closed set, so the oracle counts one unknown before that field stops the
# read. The C# region reader stopped the whole body at the cap and counted
# nothing. Found by the random pass at mutant 193624 of seed 24845619678
# (corpus seed list_shared), on the region fuzz of PR #2163.
region_list_cap_resumes listdemo Album testdata/wire/tables/fuzz-vectors/region_list_cap_resumes.bin

# A VALUE THE SKIP CANNOT HONOUR ENDS THE RECORD (§3, §4). The C# region
# measure's ExtentField ignored the result of skipping a framed scalar, so a
# map entry whose string key claimed more bytes than the entry holds left the
# reader just past the length and ExtentBody resumed inside the broken payload,
# read it as the entry's value (an inner map) and measured storage the framing
# never placed: "LoadMeasure asks for 528 region bytes; the framing commands
# exactly 512". The reference scan (internal/tablewire/extent.go) ends the
# record. Found by the region fuzz at mutant 215837 of seed 24845619678
# (corpus seed map_full, mapdemo.Fleet), on the CI of PR #2237.
region_map_skip_past_value mapdemo Fleet testdata/wire/tables/fuzz-vectors/region_map_skip_past_value.bin

# THE NODE SCAN OF A VARIABLE ROOT REFUSES NOTHING (§3.1, §4). A deletion inside
# Mixed's id table leaves eleven entries over 80 trailing bytes, so the table
# starts inside the body: three fields name ids nobody declares, and the last
# field's L falls past the body's end. The oracle's node-table scan stops at
# the damage and the body read counts it: three unknown, malformed, the value
# read. The Rust gathering scan refused the whole file on the unskippable
# field, so the load returned no root after LoadMeasure sized its region.
# Found by the random pass of the retention arm at mutant 720704 of seed
# 68719476731 (corpus seed list_mixed), on tables-rust-release run on vision;
# the plain arm refuses it the same way.
root_scan_passes_damage_to_body listdemo Mixed testdata/wire/tables/fuzz-vectors/root_scan_passes_damage_to_body.bin

# A PLAIN FLOAT'S -0 UNDER A +0 DEFAULT RIDES (§3.3). The C# writer's default
# elision compared a float32 or float64 as a VALUE, under which -0 == +0, so a
# list element's x of -0 was left off the wire and the saved bytes were 57 where
# the oracle saved 71. Elision compares bit patterns. Found by the random pass
# at mutant 237037 of seed 24845619678 (corpus seed list_scalar_widen,
# listdemo.Save), on the Certify wire fuzz.
list_float_minus_zero_default listdemo Save testdata/wire/tables/fuzz-vectors/list_float_minus_zero_default.bin

# A KEYED SLOT WRITTEN AGAIN DISCARDS WHAT WAS RETAINED UNDER IT (§6.6). Depth's
# keyed field rides twice; the first occurrence's Squad carries a roster entry
# whose value arrives under the wrong kind, so the retaining read keeps it.
# The second occurrence rewrites the same slot, and the oracle forgets the
# slot's instance, records and all, before refilling it. The Rust retaining
# reader refilled the slot and kept the first occurrence's record, so it saved
# 194 bytes where the oracle saved 174. Found by the random pass of the
# retention arm at mutant 745809 of seed 68719476731 (corpus seed map_depth),
# on tables-rust-release run on vision.
keyed_slot_rewrite_discards_retained mapdemo Depth testdata/wire/tables/fuzz-vectors/keyed_slot_rewrite_discards_retained.bin

# A BOOL PAYLOAD BYTE THAT IS NEITHER 0 NOR 1 (§3, §6.5): the value reads true
# and one malformed counts, naming the field. profile_elide with has_loadout's
# byte set to 0x11. The JavaScript variable reader read it true and counted
# nothing. Found by the random pass at mutant 18630 of seed 24845619678
# (corpus seed profile_elide), on tables-js-wire-fuzz-all; its emitter-lane
# gate is internal/codegen/jstable's TestBoolByteAboveOneIsMalformedJavaScript.
bool_byte_above_one tabledemo ProfileConfig testdata/wire/tables/fuzz-vectors/bool_byte_above_one.bin

# A RETAINING SAVE ELIDES A FIELD AT ITS DECLARED DEFAULT, not at zero (§4.2,
# §6.6). graph_tree with its root `name` reference moved to an id Scene does not
# declare: the load retains that one field, and the retaining save then wrote
# `meta { build = 1 }`, the declared default the engine elides, because the Java
# retaining writer tested scalar leaves against zero. Found by the Java leg's
# retention arm at enumerated pass reference #1 of graph_tree, run seed 1.
retain_declared_default graphdemo Scene testdata/wire/tables/fuzz-vectors/retain_declared_default.bin

# A MAP HEADER WITH A FOREIGN ELEMENT KIND COUNTS THE MISMATCH even when its
# count is spelled past the map's own L (§2.8, §4). list_of_maps with a squad's
# map cut to L = 2 over element kind 14 and a count byte that continues: the
# engine reads the count against the enclosing body, as for every bounded
# collection, and counts one kind_mismatch; the Java leg read it inside L, failed
# the spelling, and counted none. Found by the Java leg's random pass #5292 of
# list_of_maps, run seed 24845619678.
map_foreign_kind_count_past_body listdemo Army testdata/wire/tables/fuzz-vectors/map_foreign_kind_count_past_body.bin

# AN ARM'S ARRAY HEADER IS READ INSIDE THE ARM'S L (§3, the arm payload table).
# ToolMessage's body arrives as the spans arm with L = 4: element kind 2 (an i8,
# which widens into the declared i32) and a count whose LEB128 runs past the
# L. The oracle reads an arm out of a reader framed by its L, so the count is
# truncated, the arm is that arm's own framing damage, the union reads None,
# and only malformed counts. The Rust arm reader took the count from the whole
# wire and counted a widen and a clamp first. Found by the random pass at
# mutant 487423 of seed 68719476731 (corpus seed message_arms), on Certify run
# 41188400968, tables-rust-release.
arm_array_count_past_arm_length messagedemo ToolMessage testdata/wire/tables/fuzz-vectors/arm_array_count_past_arm_length.bin

# A BLOB TWO SLOTS NAME IS REFUSED BY THE RETAINING SAVE TOO (§2.5, §6.6). One
# byte of blob_small moves the `brick` Asset's `data` index from its own blob
# (node 3) to node 6, the blob Catalog's `thumb` names. The load keeps both
# slots on the one blob; every writer
# refuses that graph as blob_shared, and the oracle refuses to encode it. The C#
# retaining save numbered the region without the refusal and wrote 186 bytes.
# Found by the index pass (#33, corpus seed blob_small) of the retention arm at
# seed 24845619678, on tables-cs-release on hetzner1.
retain_blob_shared_refused blobdemo Catalog testdata/wire/tables/fuzz-vectors/retain_blob_shared_refused.bin
